ctx.x: Yeah, Jefferson is a very nice man. It's a pleasure to work for Carl, because he's a very sincere man and he's not trying to collect all the potatoes. He gives -- he probably gives the musicians that record with him a better deal than anybody else in recording business, so far as the royalty deal because that's not his thing. He's doing it out of love, really, I think, because he loves jazz. He happens to be the owner of the largest distribution for Lincoln-Mercury cars in the Bay Area and so that is actually his…
